real.review: Fixed bandpass/Hilbert mark timings at three amplitude thresholds; exact dot/dash agreement and non-overlapping within-crop intra/character gap classes. Publisher transcript supplies word spacing. All crops chosen before model/app decoding, excluding sender error and ambiguous character boundaries.
real.limits: Five correlated crops from one new operator/session, relatively clean local sidetone rather than weak RF; complements receiver-noise tests but cannot establish general weak-signal performance. Word spacing follows sender text after independent dot/dash and character-boundary validation. No model/application predictions used; upstream pretrained-model exposure unknown.
real.access: Reserve whole source session from training and tuning; reveal private manifest only after explicit candidate freeze.
real.publicationAfterRootGO: Copy private manifest unchanged to neural/corpus-final-v3.json, verify recorded SHA256, then prepare with existing neural/benchmark.py into .research/round3-real-final/manifest.json.

receiver.entryStatus: not-entered: development candidate missed required 10 percent primary improvement; complete regression checks stopped by Mac thermal constraint; no receiver runtime candidate frozen.

hard-noise-model.primary: standard rough and chaos cases combined
hard-noise-model.entryStatus: not-entered: all six control/treatment checkpoints rejected on development gates; original v6 retained.

commonGuards.standardNoiseFalseCharacters: no increase over matching baseline on the same eight minutes of negative audio
commonGuards.pauseFalseCharacters: no increase over matching baseline across scored interrupted gaps
commonGuards.candidateSelection: At most one candidate per lane, selected using development only and frozen with model/runtime/settings hashes before final generation. All applicable guards must pass. No reselection or tuning after final scores.

interpretation.multipleLanes: Two separately declared improvement lanes; passing one does not prove both. Report every frozen candidate and failed guard, plus paired uncertainty; no winner selection from final results.
interpretation.oldData: All previous development/final recordings are consumed. Regression scores may be disclosed, not presented as fresh evidence.
interpretation.freshness: Synthetic final uses new random messages/waveforms, not independent human operators. New human operator recording is being independently annotated; if unavailable, report missing real generalization rather than substitute old data.
interpretation.acquisition: Known-carrier benchmarks do not evaluate automatic carrier acquisition. Any scanner integration fix needs separate paired end-to-end checks and claims.

scoring.CER: Levenshtein errors divided by total reference characters including spaces and punctuation; uppercase and trim outer whitespace only. No dictionary correction.
scoring.aggregation: Pool errors and character counts; preserve per-clip predictions.
scoring.pauseFalseCopy: Count non-space emissions in full 0.5-second input chunks inside annotated key-up gaps starting two seconds after the last true mark and ending at the next burst or recording end. Flush copy stays in CER but not pause count.
scoring.pauseTimingLimit: Emission time is input arrival time, not acoustic token alignment. Delayed correct copy later than two seconds may count as false copy. Final trailing pauses are included.
scoring.uncertainty: Report 95% percentile interval of paired candidate-minus-baseline CER using 10000 bootstrap resamples of whole independent synthetic clips, stratified by condition. Descriptive only; point thresholds above decide the predeclared gates. Real crops within one recording are correlated and must not be treated as separate operators.

interruptedDefinition.noise: Gaussian receiver noise continues through all gaps, with static and adjacent keyed station in crowded condition. Signal fading and jitter apply to complete bursts.
interruptedDefinition.labels: All bursts are complete messages; final 1 s generated key-up plus selected 3/7/13/24 s pause. No truncation or removed keyed audio.

acquisitionLane.crowdedDefinition: Desired station starts 2–4 seconds before interferer; desired signal ends with the unchanged generator’s 1.0-second key-up tail. Evaluate actual 256-sample file-scanner final carrier separately from 160-sample live scanner updates and NeuralStream queue.
acquisitionLane.newCarrierDefinition: Old signal includes its 1.0-second tail; insert 3–6 seconds, then new signal has 0.15-second lead. True mark-to-mark gap is 4.15–7.15 seconds. The stored onset is the new recording start, 0.15 seconds before the first new mark, making the one-second acquisition guard conservative.

gates.crowdedRetention: No target jumps during established-target key-ups; file end remains on first desired station.
gates.noiseFalseCharacters: No increase in non-space output characters over baseline on the same eight minutes, separately for file and live paths.
gates.laterNewCarrier: Every case acquires new station within one second.

acquisitionLane.baseline: 9a03e0c scanner and selected CWformer v6 step2000 model, identical settings and replay.
acquisitionLane.scope: File scanner processes256-sample chunks like file.worker; live scanner processes160-sample chunks and replays actual NeuralStream queue. Four changing-carrier recordings are live-only, because file decoding assumes one selected station; exclude them from file reference denominator. No browser resampling or physical audio capture is tested.
acquisitionLane.freshness: Callsign messages are fixed by case index. New final seed changes carriers, speed, amplitude, noise and interferer onset; it does not create new text messages. This is an integration regression suite, not independent language generalization.
acquisitionLane.negativeLimit: Gaussian receiver noise at varied amplitude only; not the six broader noise classes in the standard known-carrier suite.
